answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The lotus holds work receipts rather than names, so the oasis of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
